text:
sasha: Quick heads up — I turned in my two-week notice today. Last day will be Fri Apr 23 (CET). I need help locking down final paycheck timing, benefits end date / COBRA info (Im in the US on payroll), and equipment return logistics. :wave:
michelle: Thanks for the heads up, Sasha — congrats and we'll make this as smooth as possible. I can handle benefits/COBRA and schedule an exit interview. For US employees benefits typically terminate on the last day of the month; COBRA packet goes out after termination is processed. Ill follow up with dates once payroll confirms cutoff. :calendar:
noah: Payroll note — cutoff for Apr payroll is Tue Apr 20 5pm PT. If Sashas last day is Apr 23, final pay will be in the next cycle (May payout) unless we do an off-cycle. We can request an off-cycle if there's a firm need; it needs manager approval and a payroll ticket. Also we will include accrued PTO payout per policy.
julian: Id like to request a 72h GitHub/Prod access extension after last day for a short knowledge transfer with the oncall. Is that possible? Ill own a handoff doc. :handshake:
michelle: We can approve short access extensions on a case-by-case basis. Sasha, please indicate which accounts you need extended (GH, AWS console, Datadog) when you fill the offboarding form. Approval required from manager + security.
sasha: Filing the offboarding form now. Asset return info below — laptop is company MacBook Pro, serial: C02XYZ12345, docking station asset tag: DS-9981, office badge: 6129. Im remote but can ship or drop at office depending on time.
```
- Laptop: MacBook Pro, serial C02XYZ12345
- Dock: DS-9981
- Headset: BH-550 (personal)
- Office badge: 6129
```
michelle: Thanks — please upload a clear photo of the asset tag to the asset-return form. For shipping, we can send a pre-paid label; IT will confirm. Ive put a placeholder for 72h access in the approval queue.
it-ops-bot: NOTICE: Scheduled deprovisioning workflow created for user sasha. Default policy: disable user login 48 hours after last day. Request exceptions via the offboarding form. Link: https://internal.redwood/it/offboard/1987654321
sasha: One more question on COBRA timing: when would the 60-day election window start? Is it from the termination date or the date we send paperwork?
michelle: Good question. COBRA election period starts from the later of (a) the date you would lose coverage and (b) the date you receive the election notice. Practically we treat the loss-of-coverage date as the last day of benefits (usually end of month), and we aim to mail the packet same week payroll triggers termination. Election window is 60 days from the notice or loss date (whichever gives the later deadline). Well email the packet and post a copy in passport (internal benefits portal).
noah: Also flagging final gross/net estimates: expect normal deductions through last active pay period. If you want an off-cycle to accelerate payout, julian needs to confirm and Ill open an off-cycle payroll request.
julian: I approve the off-cycle request if it helps Sasha receive final pay earlier — please proceed, Noah.
people-ops-bot: Offboarding checklist (created): https://internal.redwood/people-ops/offboard/checklist/1987654321. Items: exit interview, asset return, benefits packet, off-cycle payroll (if requested), IT deprovision.
sasha: Thanks everyone — Ive uploaded the asset photos and indicated GH + AWS console for the 72h extension in the form. Im happy to do a 30-45m handoff meeting with the oncall and add runbook notes. :+1:
michelle: Perfect — Ill schedule the exit interview for next Wed and confirm COBRA mailing date after payroll processes the termination. If anything else pops up ping me or reply here.
julian: Appreciate it, Sasha. Well make the handoff tight. :v:
